_doc: The AI opponent (src/ai/bot.gd): an economy, a build order, attack waves and counter-picks. Times in seconds; army sizes in population (large units count 2).

military._doc_healers: healers (Town Center, from age 2): one per per_army soldiers, up to max per age; kept `behind` tiles back from the army's middle (towards home); idle ones further than `follow` tiles from that spot are sent there every `every` seconds

research._doc: Besides line upgrades (and gathering, for building-up levels): the economy research it buys, and the soldiers' research it buys once that research reaches at least army_min of its soldiers (the armoury track for what it fields). Both keep back the next age's cost once the bot has the workers to age up.

wonder._doc: a Wonder (bot.gd _wonder): from `age`, with none of its own standing or going up, once its stock of every resource is at least spare_pct percent of the Wonder's cost, it lays one by its Town Center and sends `builders` workers. Every bot also attacks a Wonder it knows of (seen, or finished: everyone hears of that) before anything else, and a finished one at once

_doc_mix: economy.mix: per age, the share of workers on each resource (the bot sends idle and new workers to whatever is furthest below its share)

levels._doc: difficulty, as in the genre: easier bots build up more and fight less, but grow all game (no caps, up to the population limit). delay: seconds added to every wave's time; army_pct: the share of each wave's minimum army; army_ratio: soldiers kept (population) as a percent of its workers per age (50: half its workers in age 1, as many in age 2, one and a half in age 3; absent: no limit); wave_pct: the share of its army each wave sends (the rest defend); build_up: research gathering and line upgrades before soldiers. (Dominic: not caps; less focus on fighting, more building up.)
